name: Inspira UI
tagline: Animated UI components for Vue and Nuxt
description: A Vue and Nuxt port of the Aceternity UI and Magic UI aesthetic, built with permission from Aceternity's creator rather than as an unofficial clone. Fills a real gap: most animation-forward component sets assume React, and this one is built on shadcn-vue and Motion for Vue instead.

best.note: Component gallery built specifically for the Vue ecosystem.
